# Subway Seat for Shiki

The VS Code theme repackaged for Shiki: the same TextMate token colors as the editor. Shiki doesn't run a language server, so the extra coloring VS Code adds from semantic tokens isn't there.

[Shiki](https://shiki.style) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/shiki/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.json`](subway-seat.json) | `themes/subway-seat.json`; in your project |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.json`](subway-seat-tunnel.json) | `themes/subway-seat-tunnel.json`; in your project |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.json`](subway-seat-enamel.json) | `themes/subway-seat-enamel.json`; in your project |
| London Moquette | [`london-moquette.json`](london-moquette.json) | `themes/london-moquette.json`; in your project |
| London Deep Level | [`london-deep-level.json`](london-deep-level.json) | `themes/london-deep-level.json`; in your project |
| London Portland | [`london-portland.json`](london-portland.json) | `themes/london-portland.json`; in your project |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in your build script (Astro, VitePress, Next.js and others take the same theme object):

```typescript
import { codeToHtml } from "shiki";
import theme from "./themes/subway-seat.json" with { type: "json" };

const html = await codeToHtml(code, { lang: "ts", theme });
```

## Follow light and dark

In your build script, plus `color-scheme: light dark` on the page:

```typescript
import { codeToHtml } from "shiki";
import light from "./themes/subway-seat-enamel.json" with { type: "json" };
import dark from "./themes/subway-seat.json" with { type: "json" };

// light-dark() (Shiki 3.5+) picks a color from the page's color-scheme
const html = await codeToHtml(code, { lang: "ts", themes: { light, dark }, defaultColor: "light-dark()" });
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `themes/subway-seat.json`.
- Delete `themes/subway-seat-tunnel.json`.
- Delete `themes/subway-seat-enamel.json`.
- Delete `themes/london-moquette.json`.
- Delete `themes/london-deep-level.json`.
- Delete `themes/london-portland.json`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
